title: Anti-inflammatory Effects of S. cumini Seed Extract on Gelatinase-B (MMP-9) Regulation against Hyperglycemic Cardiomyocyte Stress.
authors: Atale, Neha; Mishra, Chandra Bhushan; Kohli, Shrey; Mongre, Raj Kumar; Prakash, Amresh; Kumari, Sweta; Yadav, Umesh C S; Jeon, Raok; Rani, Vibha
one_liner_zh: 研究黑莓种子提取物对高糖心肌细胞中MMP-9及炎症因子的调控，含多酚与明胶酶B的分子对接，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA互作，方法仅简单对接，与TF-DNA课题无关。
abstract: Black berry (Syzygium cumini) fruit is useful in curing diabetic complications; however, its role in diabetes-induced cardiomyopathy is not yet known. In this study, we investigated the regulation of gelatinase-B (MMP-9) by S. cumini methanol seed extract (MSE) in diabetic cardiomyopathy using real-time PCR, RT-PCR, immunocytochemistry, gel diffusion assay, and substrate zymography. The regulatory effects of MSE on NF-kappaB, TNF-alpha, and IL-6 were also examined. Identification and estimation of polyphenol constituents present in S. cumini extract were carried out using reverse-phase HPLC. Further, in silico docking studies of identified polyphenols with gelatinase-B were performed to elucidate molecular level interaction in the active site of gelatinase-B. Docking studies showed strong interaction of S. cumini polyphenols with gelatinase-B. Our findings indicate that MSE significantly suppresses gelatinase-B expression and activity in high-glucose- (HG-) stimulated cardiomyopathy. Further, HG-induced activation of NF-kappaB, TNF-alpha, and IL-6 was also remarkably reduced by MSE. Our results suggest that S. cumini MSE may be useful as an effective functional food and dietary supplement to regulate HG-induced cardiac stress through gelatinase.
abstract_zh: 黑莓（Syzygium cumini）果实对治疗糖尿病并发症有益；然而，其在糖尿病诱导的心肌病中的作用尚不明确。在本研究中，我们利用实时PCR、RT-PCR、免疫细胞化学、凝胶扩散试验和底物酶谱法，探讨了S. cumini甲醇种子提取物（MSE）对糖尿病心肌病中明胶酶-B（MMP-9）的调控作用。同时，还检测了MSE对NF-kappaB、TNF-alpha和IL-6的调节效应。通过反相高效液相色谱（HPLC）对S. cumini提取物中的多酚成分进行了鉴定和定量分析。此外，进行了已鉴定多酚与明胶酶-B的计算机模拟对接研究，以阐明其在明胶酶-B活性位点的分子水平相互作用。对接研究表明，S. cumini多酚与明胶酶-B之间存在强烈相互作用。我们的发现表明，MSE显著抑制了高糖（HG）刺激的心肌病中明胶酶-B的表达和活性。此外，MSE还显著降低了HG诱导的NF-kappaB、TNF-alpha和IL-6的激活。我们的结果表明，S. cumini MSE可能作为一种有效的功能性食品和膳食补充剂，通过明胶酶调控HG诱导的心脏应激。
